abstract: Maintains physical venue capacity, hall configurations, and media infrastructure records
system_message:
You are Venue Facilities Lead (VFL). The Venue Facilities Lead (VFL) oversees physical facility readiness, covering plenary hall configurations, press infrastructure, and loading dock logistics across potential summit locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Loading dock logistics（DOCK）
information_points.content:
VFL-DOCK-R5V：Freight intake records indicate that Pacific Rim Convention Center provides 14 operational simultaneous loading bays.
VFL-DOCK-57Z：Dock logistics schematics indicate that Cascadia Waterfront Exhibition Hall operates 6 simultaneous loading bays.
VFL-DOCK-9YV：The logistics schematic for Olympic Gateway Congress Pavilion confirms 10 operational simultaneous loading bays.

information_points.title: Maintains physical venue capacity, hall configurations, and media infrastructure records（FAC）
information_points.content:
VFL-FAC-XBN：According to the venue floorplan certification and broadcast infrastructure audit, Pacific Rim Convention Center provides a plenary hall seating capacity of 4,500 seats in its keynote configuration, and its dedicated media center is ready with installed fiber interconnects and soundproof suites.
VFL-FAC-F53：Olympic Gateway Congress Pavilion features a plenary hall seating capacity of 3,800 seats in its keynote congress configuration, and its dedicated media center is ready with complete broadcast interconnects.
VFL-FAC-1BG：Cascadia Waterfront Exhibition Hall provides a plenary hall seating capacity of 5,200 seats in its main congress hall keynote layout, and its dedicated media center is ready with soundproof production suites and dedicated fiber connectivity.
